rationale: Plausible and supported by high-level guidance (MISEV) and rodent data but currently unproven; no canonical evidence links MSC senescence (p16/p21, passage) to intact‑EV membrane integrity or short‑interval intranasal recoverability. Major, bounded failure modes (analytical sensitivity and orthogonality, non‑vesicular contamination, route/species delivery barriers, and process/donor confounders) must be addressed. Proceed with the proposed orthogonal intact‑EV analytics + matched short‑interval in vivo bridge, provided assays are pre‑validated for low‑biomass matrices, rigorous detergent/protease and non‑EV controls are included, multiple donor lots/replicates are tested, and prespecified acceptance/failure criteria are used; do not adopt senescence as a CMC gate until these experiments resolve the key uncertainties.
